headline: Is Johnson Controls Stock Still a Buy After an Insider Offloaded 23,400 Shares?
summary: Lei Zhang Schlitz sold 61% of his direct holdings as JCI stock surged 44% over the past year. He retains 15,017 shares worth roughly $2.31 million.
